cases.why: Owner's case, 7 Nov 2026: a captain / first officer job that needs a type rating, a commercial licence and flight hours, for a person with none of them, scored 85 'Strong match' while the card said Not eligible: No aviation experience or licences.

job.title: Captain / First Officer, Cessna Citation C525
job.description: We fly a Cessna Citation C525 (CJ1) on private charter flights across Europe. Captain: valid EASA ATPL or CPL/IR, C525 type rating, at least 1,500 flight hours, 500 on jets, class 1 medical. First Officer: valid EASA CPL/IR with multi-engine rating, C525 type rating, at least 500 flight hours. Base Zurich, roster of 12 days on and 8 off, salary by experience. Send your licence copies, logbook summary and medical certificate with your CV.

cases.why: The over-correction trap: a cadet scheme that trains a person from zero is within reach of a person with no licence, so it keeps its high search fit.

job.title: First Officer Cadet Programme (no experience required)
job.description: Become an airline first officer without any flying experience. We select candidates from any background, pay for the whole training (private licence to CPL/IR and the A320 type rating) and employ you on completion. You need: age 18 to 35, class 1 medical, fluent English, good maths, a degree or equivalent work experience. Training starts every March in Zurich.

cases.why: Baseline: golden 3001, a matching job in the person's own field stays high.
Golden 3005 (#2205): a language the profile shows unmet stays capped at 49.
The over-correction trap: a tool the profile does not mention is a gap of its own, not a disqualifier.

job.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer

We write our infrastructure in Pulumi (TypeScript) and expect you to work in it daily. Senior role, hybrid in Zurich, English working language. 7+ years of experience running production systems.
